notes: At S/PV.9518, the Council voted on the US amendment S/2023/1023, which passed with nine votes in favour, none against, and six abstentions including France. The amended draft S/2023/999 subsequently passed unanimously with 15 votes in favour. The Council then adopted Resolution 2719 regarding financing for African Union-led peace support operations.

The United States requested an explicit contribution limit to remove ambiguity regarding UN financing, enabling timely deployment. This amendment clarified the draft's reference to an "appropriate amount" as excluding full UN funding. The amendment passed unanimously, leading to the Council's unanimous adoption of Resolution 2719 on financing for African Union-led peace support operations.

France abstained on the US amendment due to insufficient clarity on financing the 25 percent outside assessed contributions, seeking predictability. While the Council unanimously adopted Resolution 2719, France reaffirmed support for assessed UN financing and prepared to discuss varying contribution levels with the EU, distinguishing its stance from the US push for explicit limits.
